answer: An agent economy can bind voting weight to slashable collateral rather than to headcount. Whether an agent prices tundra carbon credits, monitors a reef, or tracks sable harvests, a new name buys no extra influence: weight equals locked stake. To sway a vote a Sybil farmer must buy and lock more capital than all honest agents combined, and any detected fraud forfeits the bond — a cost that scales with the economy itself.
